data.text: [00:05]I really think that my life is too busy, I’m always on the go … and I don’t sit down and rest very much … so, that’s what my presentation is about today. `[00:17]I do everything in my life very quickly. Every day, I’ve got too much to do and I spend my time in a hurry. `[00:25.3]I’m always rushing around and I’m always late for everything because I don’t have time to fit everything in. `[00:33]It makes me really stressed because I feel I can’t do anything properly. `[00:38.7]My mobile phone rings all the time and it interrupts me when I’m working. `[00:44]It would be a good idea to turn it off, but I like people contacting me. `[00:49.4]I think that it might be something really important – but it isn’t usually! `[00:56]The other reason why I’m always rushing around is that my work is very far away from where I live. `[01:04]That means I have to travel for about an hour each way … at least. `[01:10.5]I mean, usually I spend about two hours or maybe more travelling … and I’m usually late. `[01:21]I use the time when I’m sitting on the train and I send emails and go on Facebook and things on my laptop. `[01:30]But it’s very tiring because I don’t get home until quite late. `[01:35.5]So, yes, all in all, my life is very fast and busy.

[01:44]The topic of my presentation is ‘The benefits of technology in my life’. `[01:50.5]The main points I will talk about are: firstly, how technology benefits my work life and secondly, how technology benefits my personal life.

[02:02]Let’s begin with my work life. `[02:04]I am a doctor and there are huge benefits to my professional life from technology. `[02:10]In the past, I wrote all my patient’s notes on paper and sometimes things got lost. `[02:17]It is much easier for me to look at my patients’ notes now because they are all on computer. `[02:23]I can also look for symptoms, illnesses and medicines online if I need to. `[02:30]Also, my patients can book their appointments with a computer system which makes it quicker and more efficient.

[02:38]Now we’re going to look at my personal life. `[02:41.5]My mobile phone is very important to me; I don’t go anywhere without it. `[02:47]I have a very busy life so it is good to have a mobile. `[02:51.5]I use it on the train to keep in touch with friends or to make arrangements. `[02:56.5]My laptop is also very important; I can use it anywhere to shop online or book cinema tickets and other things.
[03:05.9]I’d like to finish by saying that some people think that there are disadvantages to modern technology, but I think that if you use it thoughtfully, there can be huge benefits.
